Name: Sandglass Artifact of Legit Time Control
Author: Dragonfabri
Description:
Do you wish you had more time during a day? Need to water those last crops before fainting? Need to check on many villagers to give them all their gifts all around the town, only to find out they went to sleep?
Just want to relax and finally overcome the clock without cheating?
Then the Sandglass is the artifact for you!

HOW TO GET IT:
1) Head to the Traveling Cart 
2) Buy the Sandglass for 1 MILLION gold
3) Put any quantity of Iridium Ore inside to get a corresponding quantity of Sands of Time (these are stored in the Sandglass and don't take inventory space)
4) Activate the Sandglass and choose the desired effect. If you have enough sand you'll control time as you see fit! If not, start grinding those sands!


POWERS:

-) Extract Sands of Time: You can put any amount of Iridium Ore inside. If you activate the Sandglass with Iridium inside, the Ore will be crushed and instead you'll obtain 1 Sands of Time for every 1 Iridium Ore consumed. These sands are stored inside the sandglass and you can check how much you have at any time.

-) Time Stop: For 100 Sands of Time, you can pause time for 5 minutes IRL. You can activate the Sandglass again to check how much more stopped time you have left, or to restart time at no additional cost.

-) Rewind Time: For 10 Sands of Time, you can turn the clock back by one hour! Never miss a festival or appointment ever again!

-) Forward Time: For 10 sands of Time, you can move the clock forward by one hour! When you just can't wait for that event to happen!


TIME TRAVEL CONSEQUENCES (very little, but still!)

-) Stopping time should also stop villagers from moving, but not from talking or allowing shopping or anything else!

-) Forwarding time makes npcs put their newer schedule bits to work (means they will just start moving to the next spot, not be *already* there), but backwarding doesn't revert anything regarding that.

-) There are minimal bugs only with the forward time option. Kedi minimized the schedule and other time related bugs, but keep in mind they still might occur if you forward or rewind time too often. They should be for the day only, and yes it might happen if you forward time more than X times at once but its a bit dependent on how the npcs schedules are too, kind of hard to tell on a single case basis.
Nothing a good night of ingame sleep can't fix though, so just hit the hay and everything will be working once more!

Purpose:

In the vein of my other "Legit wishing" Genie Lamp mod, this is yet another mod to give you godly, cheating powers without actually cheating!
This is achieved by selling the Sandglass at an outrageous 1 Million gold (to make it available only in the very late game) plus introducing a steep, constant cost in Iridium Ores to keep its sands fueled and allow it to function. Stopping time is obviously much more powerful than just a 1 hour rewind, so the cost in sand is reflected by the price.
Forward/backward is relatively cheap, but considering you need 10 ores for every hour forward/backward it ramps up fast if using it regularly.
Stopping time is the strongest effect, justified by a whopping 100 ore cost for every 5 minutes of "free" time, a late game costly luxury that many can finally enjoy without cgeating, instead providing a huge resource sink of an already pretty valuable resource, to ensure a proper tradeoff.

As usual my thanks go to the developer i commissioned, Kedidili, who made my idea come true, and to all of you who will play it as well!
